name: Southridge Beach
summary: Along Azshara’s southern coast, Southridge Beach borders the turbulent Bay of Storms. Its broken ruins now shelter naga, murlocs, and towering sea giants.

sections.title: A Drowned Shoreline
sections.body: On Southridge Beach, the southern shore meets the turbulent Bay of Storms. Thousands of years ago, this coast belonged to Eldarath, a magnificent Highborne city. The Great Sundering broke the land and drowned most of its palaces. Crumbling marble pillars and weathered stone pavilions still dot the sand. Spitelash naga, prowling makrura, vicious hydras, and scavenging murloc tribes now contest the shore. Even massive sea giants sometimes wander ashore from the deep.

faq.answer: Southridge Beach lies in central Azshara, along the southern edge of the turbulent Bay of Storms, beneath the mainland cliffs.

faq.q: What ruins are scattered along the beach?
faq.answer: The columns and arches on the sand are the outer ruins of Eldarath, a great Highborne night elf city shattered and flooded in the Great Sundering ten thousand years ago.

faq.q: What creatures live on Southridge Beach?
faq.answer: Naga, primitive murlocs, armored makrura, and dangerous hydras occupy the shore, and sea giants sometimes roam there.

faq.q: Why are there so many naga here?
faq.answer: Naga have risen from the ocean depths to reclaim the ruins of their former civilization across Azshara. They have established a firm military presence along the Bay of Storms beaches.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Southridge Beach’s ruined architecture as a reminder of the heights of ancient Highborne civilization and its tragic fall in the Great Sundering.
